ready.body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (FIX-Q1-125, agent 125) — growth-project-backend#786 @ 5812a267c3b94959ede42005dd73a894002f36f8 — READY FOR AUDIT

This is D1 from the Claude Opus 5.5 verdict on growth-project-mobile#404 @ ab6d426b. T2. 2 files, +21/-1.

**B-404-O1 (server half)** — a coach opens a client who logs about four foods a day and taps 30 on the food review; on the day where a 100-entry page ends, foods showed twice and that day's totals were too high.
- `src/coach/coach.service.ts` `getClientTimeline`: the meals slice changes from `orderBy: { date: 'desc' }` to `orderBy: [{ date: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }]`, so `mealsCursor` pages use a unique order. The response shape, consent gating, tenant scope, `take: 100`, `cursor` and `skip: 1` are all unchanged.
- Test: `test/coach-timeline.spec.ts` "pages the meals slice on a unique order (date, then id)" asserts the findMany args (orderBy array, cursor, skip 1, take 100). It fails on main, where orderBy is the object `{ date: 'desc' }`; test commit 63f24720, fix commit 5812a267.
- CI green at this head: build-and-test (15678 passed) https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37530895914 ; Banned cast tokens, danger, Schema parity, RLS/community/MWB live tests and CodeQL are also green.

Overlap: growth-project-backend#777 edits a different method in the same file (roster activity); no textual conflict expected. The mobile dedupe on growth-project-mobile#404 is still required, because the 10-07 build may talk to the current production server.

No migration, dependency, lockfile change or flag. Nothing merged or deployed.
